meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理最近改动里的 AI 味代码,并保证回归测试仍然通过
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 AI 写了不少代码,你想删掉坏味道再合并
copy.tagline_en: Clean AI-flavored code out of recent changes while keeping tests green
copy.fit_line_en: For you if AI wrote much of your code and you want the smells gone before merging

howto.what: 它会先用回归测试锁定现有行为,再对改动文件按类别清理(如多余注释、过度防御、死代码),跑完 lint、类型检查和测试后复检,验证不通过就回滚。
howto.when: 当你说「清理」「deslop」「去掉 AI 味」等词,或要求清理最近改动时接管。默认范围是分支相对 main 的 diff,也可传入文件列表指定。

say.text: 帮我把这个分支的改动 deslop 一下
say.note: 先跑测试锁行为,再分轮清理。

say.text: 清理 src/foo.py 里的 AI 味代码
清掉最近改动里的多余注释和死代码
say.note: 质量门禁不通过就回滚。

howto.what_en: It first locks existing behavior with regression tests, then cleans the changed files by category (obvious comments, over-defensive code, dead code), runs lint, typecheck and tests, and reverts when verification fails.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff vs main; you can also pass a file list.

say_en.note: Locks behavior with tests, then cleans.

say_en.text: Clean up the AI slop in src/foo.py.
say_en.note: Only touches the files you name.

say_en.text: Remove redundant comments and dead code from recent changes.
